{{Quote|Flame and famine! You spoiled the run, Vuffi Raa—it’s the Destroyed Starship!|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Lando">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>}}
'''The Destroyed Starship''' was a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] card exclusive to the [[Centran sabacc/Legends|Centran]] variant of the game. As a face card, it only appeared once in the deck. In addition to being played, the card carried meaning in cartomancy. When drawn for the position representing the immediate future, The Destroyed Starship foretold cataclysmic changes, death, and destruction. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] considered it the worst card in the deck.<ref name="Lando" />
